Class BossBarCommand

java.lang.Object
com.animationlib.impl.BossBarCommand
public final class BossBarCommand extends Object
/animationbossbar show <id> <target> <color> <image|none> <title>: shows a boss bar named id for one living entity, filled by its health (see BossBar.bossbar(String, BossEvent.BossBarColor, String, Identifier, LivingEntity)), e.g. /animationbossbar show boss1 @e[type=zombie,limit=1] red none Big Zombie. The image is the id of a PNG in assets/<namespace>/animationlib/bossbar/ (or none for the vanilla bar), the title is the rest of the command, and showing the same id again updates that bar.

color is either one of vanilla's named colors (as above), or a 6-digit hex RGB value, e.g. /animationbossbar show boss1 @s ff8800 image Big Zombie (no #: the argument is a single unquoted word, which can't contain one). With an image, an RGB color tints it. With none, it replaces the vanilla bar texture with a solid bar in that color instead (the vanilla texture itself only ever takes one of the named colors). /animationbossbar remove <id> removes it again.

Named differently from vanilla's /bossbar, which manages its own, separate bars.
